attributes.name: footer photo treatment
attributes.definition: How photography is used in or directly above the footer area.

values.definition: A photo cropped into a non-rectangular (e.g. curved) shape placed within the footer.
A wide, full-bleed decorative photo strip sits above the footer.
No photo in or adjacent to the footer, or another treatment.

attributes.name: footer decorative accents
attributes.definition: Decorative graphic motifs applied in the footer.

values.definition: Halftone or dot-pattern ornament in the footer.
No special decorative motif or a different one.

attributes.name: social links style
attributes.definition: How social media links are presented.

values.definition: Plain text labels with underline accent, no icons.
No social links, or another form.

attributes.name: photo-to-panel blending
attributes.definition: Whether photography merges seamlessly with adjacent solid-colored panels.

values.definition: Dark photos fade or match into neighboring dark sections without a hard edge.
Photos are clearly separated from adjacent panels.

attributes.name: footer brand and legal row
attributes.definition: How the logo and copyright appear in the footer.

values.definition: A small logo repeated in the footer alongside the copyright line.
